title: Looking back at 2026
text: Good evening gentlemen, and welcome to the 2027 introductory video for the club. 2026 was a very successful year for us. We played in 307 games, and we won 207 of them. But most importantly, after seven years of playing together, we did it. We won our first club finals championship. What a way to cap off the year.

title: Previous-season awards
text: We had some very impressive individual performances for the season itself. To start with, a Breakout Player of the Year and top defenseman, Gotta Be. Next, between the pipes every year, Jene Rene got the best Goalkeeper of the Year award. After him, Slobby Robby, he won Unsung Hero of the Year award, picking up what needs to be picked up when no one else is gonna do it. And finally, leading the club in almost every single category, setting records for the club, our MVP, Xavier Laflamme. 26 gave us a lot to build on. We're ready to see what's next in 27.

title: The new season
text: And with the new year, as always, we're changing. New season, new look, and new leadership.

title: Captain
text: Starting with our captain, wearing the C this year will be Xavier Laflamme.

title: Assistant captain
text: Joining him as assistant captain this year, it will be Matt Hut.

title: The jerseys
text: And finally, the announcement we've been waiting for, our new jerseys for the NHL 2027 year. Here they are.

title: Uniform reveal and closing cards
text: Music continues while the home, away and alternate uniforms are shown. Home: teal with purple and white striping. Away: white with teal and purple striping. Alternate: purple with teal and white striping. The closing cards read: “Last year, we made history.” “This year, we defend it.” “Bardownski Hockey Club” and “www.bardownski.hockey.”
